podcast.body: This self-titled Indie EP was the band's first proper, official, and authorized record, released on December 11, 1987. It was primarily stocked by a few record stores in Kingston but still managed to sell 2000 copies locally within a couple of weeks. "The first proper official and authorized hip record was released on December 11, 1987. It was a cell titled IndieP stocked only by a couple of record stores in Kingston, but still the damn thing sold 2000 copies in just a couple of weeks, all locally."

podcast.body: This self-titled debut EP was recorded in Toronto and served as a calling card to attract interest from record labels. It caught the attention of Bruce Dickinson, then-president of MCA Records, and was later reissued after the band signed their deal. "A self-telling debut EP was recorded in Toronto, and this became their calling card to drum interest with some record labels."
